# Area instruction router

Root `AGENTS.md` is canonical. Load only the files relevant to the change.

| Change | Read |
|---|---|
| Any production code | `core-engineering.md` |
| Tests, fixtures, CI test gates | `testing.md` |
| UI, interaction, styles, localization | `ui.md` |
| User documentation | `documentation.md` |
| Auth, secrets, external requests, dependencies | `security.md` |
| Git, parallel agents, commits | `git-and-sessions.md` |

Existing project instructions keep their scope. If two rules conflict, surface the conflict and ask for a ruling; do not silently pick one.
